```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 3.25
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(magick)
library(grid)

uhu <- image_read("uhu4measure.png") |> 
    image_flop() |> 
    image_resize(geometry = geometry_size_percent(50)) |> 
    image_transparent("white")

uhuloa <- function(loa = 1) {
    par(mar = rep(0, 4))
    plot(0:50, type = "n")
    rect(-0.5, 6, 50.5, 13, col = "gray")
    text(0.5, 7, labels = "cm", cex = 0.75)
    
    segments(x0 = 0, y0 = 12, x1 = 50, lwd = 0.5)
    segments(x0 = 0:50, y0 = 10, y1 = 12, lwd = 0.5)
    segments(x0 = (0:49) + 0.5, y0 = 10.75, y1 = 12, lwd = 0.5)
    segments(x0 = seq(0.1, 49.9, by = 0.1), y0 = 11.25, y1 = 12, lwd = 0.25)
    
    text(0:50, rep(11, 51), labels = 0:50, cex = 0.5, pos = 1)
    
    
    xr <- par("usr")[1:2]
    p <- 1
    grid.raster(uhu, x = (0 - xr[1]) / diff(xr), 
                hjust = 0, width = loa * 50 / diff(xr)) 
}

set.seed(123)
ll <- runif(300, min = 0.4, max = 0.8)

for(i in ll) {
    uhuloa(i)
}
```
